ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Teaching Art at the College Level. This is not a teacher training course. The principal aim of this course is to pool together and examine a range of teaching practices and philosophies which emerge as best practices in the art and design school. This course is designed for graduate students who plan to make teaching part of their professional goals once their MFA is completed. Through a mutual understanding that teaching at this level is varied, complex, and situational, the participants in this course will undertake a collective research project which will open up a critical discourse about teaching art and design at the college level. Important text that examine the history, philosophies, practices and trajectories of the contemporary art school will be examined by the group.
